package fixture

// RED: two bare Stop statements. Both throw away ErrStopDeadline without
// saying so, and both must be flagged, in this order.

import "context"

type proc interface{ Stop(context.Context) error }

type dest struct{ proc proc }

func teardown(p proc, d *dest, ctx context.Context) {
	p.Stop(ctx)
	d.proc.Stop(ctx)
}
